verdict.rationale: Docs confirm locations/zones for managing readers across multiple physical sites, reader registration tied to a location, and unified Dashboard reporting for in-person and online payments, which supports multi-location fleet management. However, there is no explicit evidence of per-location settings customization (e.g., location-specific tax, receipt, or tipping configs) or per-location reporting breakdowns beyond the general unified Dashboard. missing for 10: explicit per-location settings/config differentiation, per-location reporting/analytics breakdown, independent hands-on validation of multi-location fleet workflows at scale.
